id: title:dmarticus:move suggested reviewers info icon into section header

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the placement of a help tooltip and its associated icon from the bottom row of the Suggested Reviewers section to the section header, potentially improving discoverability of routing behavior.
review.reason: Adds a tooltip and an info icon to the section header while removing a separate tooltip and its container from the bottom row. The tooltip text explicitly references PostHog's use of suggestions for report routing and GitHub review requests. This is a localized UI change, not a systemic or backend improvement.
review.uncertainty: The complete relationship between this hunk and other potential hunks is unknown, and the actual user benefit of the tooltip placement change is not demonstrated by the code, only inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between PRs can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a tooltip and an info icon to the section header, while removing a separate tooltip and its container from the bottom row. Also removes the explicit 'collapsible' prop from the JSX and the 'collapsible' prop from the DetailSection, while retaining the collapsible behavior. The tooltip is moved to the header, and the bottom row no longer contains the tooltip. The tooltip text:
observations.code_quote: <Tooltip title="PostHog uses these suggestions to route the report. Add reviewers on the pull request to request a GitHub review.">
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the placement of a help tooltip and its associated icon from the bottom row of the Suggested Reviewers section to the section header. This could help users discover the routing behavior while viewing the section, rather than only when they reach the bottom. The tooltip is retained, not removed, so the information is preserved.
